name: Molecular and Cell Biology PhD
detailsNote: Department publishes undated January1 fall-only admission. Fall2027 calendar date not explicitly confirmed; department instructions take precedence over conflicting central spring listings.

publishedDeadlines.note: Department states fall-only admission; no explicit year.
publishedDeadlines.label: Fall departmental application

documents: Statement of academic goals and research interests naming relevant faculty/areas
Official transcripts from all college-level institutions; foreign records in original language and English

applicationFee.note: Conditional central categories: current Peace Corps volunteers, Horizons, McNair, Project1000 and UMBC employees; certain continuing/change-of-program applicants also exempt. No central financial-hardship waivers. Confirm international eligibility for an applicable category or ask department about sponsorship.

requirements.note: Four-year accredited bachelor-equivalent required. Recommended biology-related preparation: calculus one semester, organic chemistry two semesters with lab, physics two semesters, genetics and cell biology one semester each. Computational entrants may qualify using their degree programming/biology background; CBS biology/chemistry entrants need basic programming. Research experience preferred, not required. GRE scores may be submitted voluntarily but are waived. Prior research-mentor arrangement not required at application. Three research rotations precede dissertation research. WES ICAP course-by-course report sent directly can replace official transcripts; evaluation optional.

english.toefl: 80 before January21,2026;4 on/after that date; Essentials8.5
english.note: Central minima; DET accepted by most programs, confirm program acceptance. PTE Academic53, TOEFL MyBest accepted. English-country/institution exemptions may apply under linked guidelines; detailed exemption document did not render, so no automatic overseas English-medium exemption established.

funding.note: Department describes accepted PhD students in good standing as supported by RA, TA or external fellowship. Program-specific amount, tuition/insurance terms and international guarantee not established for this affiliated program.
